limitations.description: 9 of 10 CrowdStrike incidents are the identical binary (UltraViewer_Service.exe). Observations are strongly correlated and do not represent 10 independent samples.
With n=20, a 95% Wilson score confidence interval spans approximately +/- 18% to 22%. The benchmark cannot establish fine-grained statistical discrimination between 80% and 90% true model capability.
Only 2 FortiSIEM rule families are represented. Findings cannot be generalized to Windows Security Event logs, firewall anomalies, or cloud audit trails.
